description: This file contains the implementation of RetrieveThingsLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, a builder class used for creating responses to a RetrieveThingsLiveCommand within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested classes and methods to build response objects with specified fields and predicates.
